chose: A draw for a week after the one Quests was opened in reads its facts at the week's start, with the first day's kudos all left, and stores the week's start as drawnAt; an award counts when it was made at or after drawnAt
over: my earlier call to keep drawnAt as the real draw time and compare the week key of the Quests opening at count time
because: the GPT-6.1 Sol review showed an on-demand draw read facts after the award that triggered it: it could drop quests that award pursued, and a late draw could find nothing feasible and lose the award; facts and time at the week's start make the draw the one Monday 00:00 would have made, and drop the special case at count time

chose: Leave the draw's facts reading the whole workspace directory and the giver's award history, as #121 built them, and file bounded facts as a follow-up
over: rewriting drawFactsOf onto indexed counts or maintained facts in this ticket
because: the GPT-6.1 Sol review found a draw fails past Convex's 32000-document scan limit (32001 members, or 32000 awards from one giver); the limit predates this ticket, unlocks' launch scans the directory the same way, no workspace is near it, and bounding it changes how feasibility is computed, which is #121's draw rather than this ticket's schedule
